description: This file declares the interface class 'IFactories' within the 'WPEFramework::PluginHost' namespace. The class provides factory methods to create proxy objects for various web-related types such as Request, Response, FileBody, and JSONRPC. It also includes static methods for managing a singleton instance of the factory and checking its availability.

classes.name: IFactories
classes.description: An interface class that defines factory methods for creating web-related proxy objects.
